name: us-stock-ai-trader
description: 美股 AI 自動化交易系統 — Paper Trading MVP

services.name: api
services.buildCommand: corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @app/api db:generate && pnpm --filter @app/api db:deploy && pnpm --filter @app/api build

services.name: dashboard
services.buildCommand: corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @app/dashboard build
